pip-compile.description: Hash-locked Python tools of ci-ansible.yml (.github/actions/setup-ansible): Renovate bumps the pin in the .in file and re-runs the `uv pip compile` command recorded in the .txt header, hashes included.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh the transitive dependencies (and their hashes) of the locked ansible tools above, so security fixes land without waiting for a direct-dependency release.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as literals inside workflows and composite actions (promtool, yq, gitleaks, actionlint, kubeconform, shellcheck, bats, terraform). The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs and container images — a version baked into a download URL or a workflow input default is invisible to it, so it silently rots.

Docker image pinned by tag AND digest in a workflow input default (perf-sitespeed.yml). The generic manager above requires a numeric default, which an image reference is not; this one keeps tag and digest moving together.

prek hook revs (prek.toml) — inline renovate comments (datasource=github-tags). No manager understands prek/pre-commit TOML, so without this the hook pins only move when someone remembers to run `prek autoupdate`.

packageRules.description: Self-references (`KevinDeBenedetti/github-workflows/...`) are this very repo — the workflows reach their own actions with `uses: $/…` (no ref), and the examples' pins are bumped by release-please (x-release-please-version), never by Renovate.

These versions are stored WITHOUT the leading v (the download URL adds it back), while the upstream tags carry it — strip it so comparisons work. Scoped to .github/: prek.toml pins rhysd/actionlint WITH the v.
These tools are downloaded and verified against a SHA-256 (or commit) pinned next to the version: Renovate bumps the version only, so the job fails closed until the pins are refreshed.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Pinned checksums: run `scripts/update-tool-checksums.py` on this branch and commit the result — CI fails until then.

packageRules.description: actionlint >= 1.7.12 ships stale metadata for actions/create-github-app-token@v3 (false positives on `client-id`): callers of the actionlint action that do not pass `-ignore create-github-app-token` would break. Bumps need a deliberate approval from the dependency dashboard.
promtool and yq are installed by the same step in ci-prometheus.yml — one PR, one review.
